verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS virtual-mailbox product, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The documented automation rules, Zapier integration and gated API are adjacent automation or developer building blocks, not an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
